_notes.template: Affiliate tracking template per merchant. Use {url} as the encoded deep-link placeholder. Examples — Impact: https://ticketmaster.pxf.io/c/PUBID/ADID/CAMPID?u={url} · Partnerize: https://prf.hn/click/camref:CAMREF/destination:{url} · Leave empty to use plain links until your affiliate accounts are approved.
_notes.priority: Button order on event pages — put the highest effective commission first (StubHub ~4% fast payout, TickPick 4% slow payout, Ticketmaster up to 5% resale but ~1.5% primary, Vivid 1-2%). Re-order once you see real EPC per merchant in your analytics.
_notes.analytics.goatcounter: Free, privacy-friendly analytics. Sign up at goatcounter.com and put your https://YOURCODE.goatcounter.com/count URL here — pageviews plus per-merchant outbound click counts appear automatically.
_notes.ntfy.opsTopic: Private topic for YOU: the GitHub Action pings it if a refresh run fails, so the site can never go silently stale. Subscribe in the ntfy app.
_notes.siteBase: Change when you move to a custom domain. Used for canonical URLs, sitemap, RSS and alert links.
